title: Add second hardcoded admin seed account (admin / Admin@1234)

requirements.text: In `backend/main.mo`, add a second hardcoded admin seed account with username `admin` and password `Admin@1234` (role: `admin`) to both `system func init()` and `system func postupgrade()`. This account must be upserted into stable storage alongside the existing `genmitra` admin seed every time the canister is initialized or upgraded, so that logging in with username `admin` and password `Admin@1234` grants admin access.

quotes: I'll add a seeded admin account with a new set of credentials (username: `admin`, password: `Admin@1234`) in addition to the existing `genmitra` admin.

acceptanceCriteria: The `system func init()` in `backend/main.mo` upserts a user record with username `admin`, password `Admin@1234`, and role `admin` into stable storage.
The `system func postupgrade()` in `backend/main.mo` also upserts the same `admin` / `Admin@1234` / role `admin` record, ensuring it is present after every canister upgrade.
The existing `genmitra` admin seed (password: 12345678) and `genmitra` user seed (password: 1234) are unaffected.
Logging in via the frontend with username `admin` and password `Admin@1234` successfully authenticates as admin and redirects to the admin panel.
The backend migration file (`backend/migration.mo`) is updated if needed to carry forward the new seed on upgrade without losing existing user records.

constraints: Do not change or remove the existing genmitra admin seed (username: genmitra, password: 12345678, role: admin).
Do not change or remove the existing genmitra user seed (username: genmitra, password: 1234, role: user).
All Motoko logic must remain in the single actor file backend/main.mo.
nonGoals: Adding a UI for dynamically creating admin accounts from the admin panel.
Changing any frontend authentication flow or login page.
Modifying any existing product, template, or order logic.
